description: Headphones, true wireless earbuds and speakers from Sony, Bose, Apple, JBL and more.

subcategories.name: Headphones
subcategories.description: Over-ear and on-ear headphones: noise cancelling, wireless, studio monitoring.

products.name: Sony WH-1000XM3 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
products.short: Industry-leading noise cancelling with 30-hour battery and quick charging.
products.description:
Sony's flagship over-ear headphones combine the HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN1 with dual noise sensors to block out planes, trains and open offices.

  • Adaptive noise cancelling with Ambient Sound mode
  • Up to 30 hours of battery, 10 min charge = 5 h playback
  • Touch controls and Quick Attention mode
  • Foldable design with hard carry case

products.name: Bose QuietComfort 35 II Wireless Headphones
products.short: Legendary Bose noise cancelling with Google Assistant and Alexa built in.
products.description:
The QuietComfort 35 II pair three levels of world-class noise cancelling with balanced, volume-optimised audio and all-day comfort.

  • Three adjustable noise cancelling levels
  • Up to 20 hours of wireless playback
  • Action button for Google Assistant or Amazon Alexa
  • Dual-microphone system for clear calls

products.name: Apple AirPods Max
products.short: High-fidelity audio, Active Noise Cancellation and spatial audio in a premium over-ear design.
products.description:
AirPods Max reimagine over-ear headphones with an Apple-designed dynamic driver, computational audio and a breathable knit-mesh canopy.

  • Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode
  • Personalised Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking
  • Apple H1 chip in each ear cup, 20 h battery
  • Digital Crown for precise volume control

specs.Processor: Apple H1 chip in each ear cup

products.name: Audio-Technica ATH-M50 Professional Studio Monitor Headphones
products.short: Critically acclaimed closed-back studio monitors with 45 mm drivers.
products.description:
A studio favourite for mixing, tracking and DJ monitoring, the ATH-M50 delivers accurate, extended-range sound with deep, controlled bass.

  • 45 mm large-aperture drivers with rare-earth magnets
  • Closed-back circumaural design for excellent isolation
  • 90° swiveling ear cups for one-ear monitoring
  • Coiled cable with 6.3 mm screw-on adapter

specs.Connectivity: Wired, 3.5 mm coiled cable (6.3 mm adapter)

products.name: Sony WH-CH510 Wireless On-Ear Headphones
products.short: Lightweight wireless on-ear headphones with up to 35 hours of battery.
products.description:
An affordable everyday companion: the WH-CH510 weigh just 132 g and keep playing for up to 35 hours on a single charge.

  • Up to 35 h battery with USB-C quick charging
  • 30 mm drivers tuned for clear, balanced sound
  • Built-in mic for hands-free calls and voice assistants
  • Swivel ear cups for easy storage

products.name: Sony MDR-7506 Professional Studio Headphones
products.short: The broadcast and studio industry standard for over 30 years.
products.description:
Found in radio studios and on film sets worldwide, the MDR-7506 offer detailed, punchy sound and a rugged folding design.

  • 40 mm neodymium drivers, 10 Hz – 20 kHz
  • Closed-ear design for strong isolation
  • 3 m coiled cord with gold-plated 3.5/6.3 mm plug
  • Folds compactly, soft carrying pouch included

specs.Connectivity: Wired, 3 m coiled cable, 3.5/6.3 mm gold plug

products.name: Sennheiser Momentum Over-Ear Headphones
products.short: Audiophile sound in a stainless-steel and genuine leather design.
products.description:
The original Sennheiser Momentum blends rich, natural sound with premium materials: a brushed stainless-steel headband and soft leather ear pads.

  • Rich bass and crisp highs from Sennheiser transducers
  • Closed design with noise isolating ear pads
  • Detachable cable with in-line remote and mic
  • Stainless steel and leather construction

specs.Connectivity: Wired, detachable cable with in-line remote

products.name: Bose QuietComfort 25 Acoustic Noise Cancelling Headphones
products.short: Wired noise cancelling headphones with 35 hours on a single AAA battery.
products.description:
The QuietComfort 25 bring Bose noise cancelling to a lightweight, foldable wired design, perfect for flights and long commutes.

  • Acoustic noise cancelling, still plays passively when off
  • About 35 hours from a single AAA battery
  • In-line remote and mic
  • Folds flat into the included carry case

subcategories.name: Earbuds
subcategories.description: True wireless earbuds with noise cancelling, long battery life and wireless charging.

products.name: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd generation)
products.short: Up to 2× more Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio and a MagSafe charging case.
products.description:
Powered by the Apple H2 chip, AirPods Pro (2nd generation) deliver richer bass, crisper highs and noise cancelling that adapts to your environment.

  • Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio and Transparency mode
  • Personalised Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking
  • Touch control for volume on the stem
  • MagSafe charging case with speaker and lanyard loop

products.name: Apple AirPods (2nd generation)
products.short: The classic AirPods with the H1 chip, hands-free Siri and 24 hours with the case.
products.description:
Easy setup, automatic switching between Apple devices and quick access to Siri make AirPods the simplest way to go wireless.

  • Apple H1 chip for fast, stable connection
  • “Hey Siri” always on
  • Up to 5 h listening, 24 h with the charging case
  • Double-tap to play, skip or answer calls

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Buds2 Pro
products.short: 24-bit Hi-Fi sound, intelligent ANC and 360 Audio in a compact, comfortable fit.
products.description:
Galaxy Buds2 Pro bring studio-quality 24-bit Hi-Fi audio and intelligent noise cancelling in a design 15% smaller than before.

  • Intelligent Active Noise Cancellation with voice detect
  • 24-bit Hi-Fi audio and 360 Audio with head tracking
  • IPX7 water resistance
  • Wireless charging case

specs.Battery Life: 5 h ANC on (18 h with case)

products.name: Sony WF-1000XM4 Noise Cancelling Earbuds
products.short: Sony's Integrated Processor V1, Hi-Res LDAC audio and 24 hours of battery.
products.description:
The WF-1000XM4 pair Sony's Integrated Processor V1 with new noise isolation tips for deep, effective noise cancelling in a small, ergonomic design.

  • Industry-leading noise cancelling, Processor V1
  • High-Resolution Audio Wireless with LDAC
  • 8 h with ANC, 24 h total with case
  • Speak-to-Chat and IPX4 splash resistance

specs.Battery Life: 8 h ANC on (24 h with case)

products.name: Jabra Elite 8 Active
products.short: The world's toughest earbuds: IP68, military-grade durability and adaptive ANC.
products.description:
Built for sport and the outdoors, Jabra Elite 8 Active combine ShakeGrip technology that keeps them in place with rugged IP68 protection.

  • Adaptive Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation
  • IP68 earbuds, tested to military standard MIL-STD-810H
  • 8 h with ANC, 32 h with the case
  • Dolby Audio spatial sound

specs.Battery Life: 8 h ANC on (32 h with case)

products.name: Google Pixel Buds Pro
products.short: Active Noise Cancellation with Silent Seal and hands-free Google Assistant.
products.description:
Pixel Buds Pro use a custom 6-core audio chip and Silent Seal to adapt to your ears, cancelling more noise while keeping music full and rich.

  • Active Noise Cancellation with Silent Seal
  • Up to 7 h listening with ANC, 20 h with case
  • Hands-free “Hey Google” and real-time translation
  • Multipoint connection between devices

specs.Battery Life: 7 h ANC on (20 h with case)

products.name: Nothing Ear (1)
products.short: Transparent design, active noise cancellation and wireless charging at an accessible price.
products.description:
Nothing's debut earbuds show off their internals with a transparent design and pack ANC, wireless charging and custom 11.6 mm drivers.

  • Active Noise Cancellation (Light / Maximum) and Transparency
  • 11.6 mm drivers tuned with Teenage Engineering
  • Up to 34 h total with the case (ANC off)
  • Wireless charging and IPX4 splash resistance

specs.Battery Life: 4 h ANC on (24 h with case)

subcategories.name: Speakers
subcategories.description: Portable Bluetooth speakers and smart speakers for every room.

products.name: JBL Flip 4 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
products.short: Waterproof portable speaker with powerful stereo sound and 12 hours of playtime.
products.description:
The JBL Flip 4 is a rugged, waterproof portable speaker that delivers surprisingly powerful stereo sound wherever you go.

  • IPX7 waterproof, pool- and beach-ready
  • Up to 12 hours of playtime
  • JBL Connect+ to link 100+ speakers
  • Noise-cancelling speakerphone

products.name: JBL Charge 4 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
products.short: Bold JBL sound, 20 hours of playtime and a built-in power bank.
products.description:
The JBL Charge 4 combines a long-excursion driver and dual passive radiators for deep bass, with a built-in power bank to keep your phone topped up.

  • Up to 20 hours of playtime
  • Built-in USB power bank
  • IPX7 waterproof
  • JBL Connect+ for multi-speaker parties

specs.Charging: USB-C in, USB-A power bank out

products.name: Sonos One (Gen 2) Smart Speaker
products.short: Rich, room-filling sound with Alexa and Google Assistant built in.
products.description:
Sonos One is a compact smart speaker with remarkably rich sound, voice control and seamless multi-room streaming over Wi-Fi.

  • Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant built in
  • Apple AirPlay 2 support
  • Trueplay tuning adapts sound to your room
  • Pair two for stereo or add to a home theatre

products.name: Amazon Echo Dot (3rd Gen) Smart Speaker with Alexa
products.short: Compact smart speaker with Alexa: music, news, timers and smart home control.
products.description:
Echo Dot is Amazon's most popular smart speaker, with a fabric design and improved speaker for richer, louder sound.

  • Voice control with Alexa
  • Control compatible smart lights, plugs and cameras
  • Stream music from popular services
  • Microphone off button for privacy

products.name: Ultimate Ears BOOM 2 Wireless Speaker
products.short: 360° sound, waterproof and shockproof, with 15 hours of battery.
products.description:
UE BOOM 2 fills any space with loud, immersive 360° sound and is built to survive drops, dust and dunks.

  • 360° sound with deep bass
  • Waterproof (IPX7) and shockproof
  • Up to 15 hours of battery
  • Tap the top to play, pause or skip

products.name: Bose SoundLink Mini II Bluetooth Speaker
products.short: Full, natural Bose sound from a palm-sized aluminium speaker.
products.description:
SoundLink Mini II packs full, natural sound into a compact aluminium body you can take anywhere.

  • Two custom transducers and dual passive radiators
  • Up to 10 hours of battery
  • Built-in speakerphone
  • Charging cradle included

products.name: Apple HomePod mini
products.short: Room-filling 360° sound, Siri and smart home hub in a compact sphere.
products.description:
HomePod mini uses computational audio to deliver rich, 360° sound and acts as a home hub for your smart accessories.

  • 360° audio with computational tuning
  • Siri for music, timers and smart home control
  • Intercom and Handoff with iPhone
  • Thread border router for Matter devices

products.name: Marshall Kilburn II Portable Speaker
products.short: Iconic Marshall design with 360° sound and 20+ hours of portable playtime.
products.description:
Kilburn II brings Marshall's legendary rock-and-roll styling to a rugged portable speaker with loud, multi-directional sound.

  • Multi-directional, 360° sound
  • More than 20 hours of portable playtime
  • Analogue bass and treble knobs
  • IPX2 water resistance and a leather strap
